added_failures_note: the reviewed run carries no armed baseline_suite/after_suite (both keys empty in its manifest), so the added-failure count is taken from its own recorded gate logs: gate-head.log at 09c342947c75607bb537619449ae5bfc55af5fc5 and gate-repair.log at f178cf307d9e9cd13218416bca2183a889a004e6, both ending EXIT=0 with 0 failing tests (3 passed, 16 passed). Both of the two added failing ids the manifest reports at the merge candidate (tests/test_held_worktrees_read_run_files.py::test_a_mixed_state_goes_to_the_run[node-id-differs-from-tree-name] and tests/test_a_sweep_resolves_review_heads_once.py::test_one_derivation_builds_the_index_once) pass in the repair gate, so the repair added none.

findings.text: follow-on: assert counts.deepcopy <= TREE_COUNT admits one copy per tree (15) while the done_when bounds the derivation at one copy per document handed to a mutating caller, and this derivation hands nothing to a mutating caller so the measured figure is 0; reverting the read-only sharing while keeping the screen still passes at head, so the copy bound the goal names is asserted but not guarded. Reinstating the regression (drop read_only_region, share nothing) still satisfies this line.

follow-on: assert counts.stat <= RECORD_COUNT + TREE_COUNT * 3 (545) is looser than the done_when's at-most-once-per-document (500); the base tree's own recorded 519 stats satisfy it, so this assertion cannot fail on the stat bound it claims to measure and does not discriminate head from base.

follow-on: inside a read-only region the freshly computed value is stored in the process-wide _CACHE itself (not a copy as the non-region path at :125 does) and returned uncopied, so the cache now holds the object the derivation also holds; a region caller that mutates a document returned in the region corrupts the shared entry for every later reader, and the mutable=True escape hatch added at :76 is called nowhere in the repository, so the read-only contract the docstring states is unenforced and untested.

follow-on: the fragment's first paragraph (id the-held-worktree-read-is-bounded-what) still states the screen the repair replaced — 'whose node id names a registered, inspected tree' and 'reads each run's node id from the ledger's own picker projection' — contradicting both the second paragraph and the landed code at reckon/crew/obligations.py:537, which keys on both routes and reads ledger.runs rather than picker_runs. The commit that claimed to update the fragment added only the corrective paragraph and left this one stale.

follow-on: negative_control_note describes the negative-control log as 'the head test file against a base-revision tree', but negative-control.log was produced with the 09c342947c75 revision of the test file (it calls indexes.picker_runs and test_a_tree_reused_under_a_foreign_parent_stays_a_candidate, and fails the second test on AttributeError: _may_name_a_tree), not the reviewed head f178cf307, whose test file renames and reworks that case. The read-bound failure the note quotes is genuine and the log still admits (EXIT=1, test_one_derivation_reads_only_the_documents_that_can_change_it fails at base and passes at head), but the note misdescribes which test file produced the log.

justifications.durability: tests/test_the_held_worktree_read_is_bounded.py:224 fails at the base revision (500 decodes) and :244 tests/test_a_run_retaining_another_nodes_tree_stays_a_candidate fails if the retained route is dropped from reckon/crew/obligations.py:537, so the read bound and the repaired screen are guarded; :225 is satisfied even if the read-only sharing is reverted, so the copy bound is unguarded.

justifications.fit: the screen and the region follow the module idiom at reckon/crew/obligations.py:484 and the repository's ContextVar-region pattern, but reckon/file_memo.py:42 starts a fresh cache at every entry rather than joining a nested region as reckon/ledger.py:1379 index_reuse does, and the mutable parameter added at reckon/file_memo.py:76 is dead.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/obligations.py:651 filters every per-run document through _may_name_a_tree before _run_file_record, and reckon/file_memo.py:117 hands the decoded document on uncopied inside the region, so one fleet_state decodes 15 documents and copies 0 over the 500-document home.
justifications.reuse: reckon/file_memo.py is the memo's owner and the region extends it rather than forking; the screen at reckon/crew/obligations.py:514 reuses routing's _retained_worktree helper rather than restating the naming rule, and a search of reckon for a document-sharing region found ledger.index_reuse and recovery_review_dispatch.review_heads_resolve_once, which cache a run index and a head resolution rather than memoised documents.
justifications.scope_discipline: the base..head diff lists only reckon/crew/obligations.py, reckon/file_memo.py, tests/test_the_held_worktree_read_is_bounded.py and the landing fragment, every one inside the declared write paths and none reaching the figures directory.
